caption: A powerful motorcycle revs its engine at a kerb, and the leaves of a potted plant on the pavement beside it quiver.

sa.check: A motorcycle stands at a kerb.
A potted plant stands on the pavement beside it.
The motorcycle is revved: a hand on the throttle, an exhaust puff or the bike's own shudder marks it.
The motorcycle stays in place; it does not ride off.

pc.expect: The leaves tremble on their stems while the pot and the base of the stem stay fixed.
pc.fail: The pot slides along the pavement; or the whole plant bends over and stays bent; or leaves float away from the plant; or the leaves keep their exact pose frozen while the pot itself trembles.

pc.expect: The leaves quiver while the bike shudders or puffs exhaust and settle when it calms.
pc.fail: The bike shudders for a spell and the leaves stay frozen; or the leaves quiver hard while the bike sits with no shudder and no exhaust puff; or the leaves start before the bike shows any sign of running.
pc.precondition: The motorcycle's shudder or its exhaust puffs are visible.

pc.expect: Leaves hang from their stems and the pot rests on the ground; anything that comes free falls.
pc.fail: A leaf that comes free rises; or the pot lifts; or the plant hangs upward.

pc.expect: The leaves flex as thin leaves and the stems bend; the pot is rigid.
pc.fail: The pot flexes like rubber; or the leaves swing as stiff boards; or the stems stretch.

pc.expect: One bike, one plant; leaves do not multiply.
pc.fail: A second plant appears; or the plant vanishes; or the bike passes through the kerb; or leaves multiply in one frame.

pc.expect: The bike's colour, the pot's pattern and the leaves' colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The bike changes colour; or the pot changes pattern; or the leaves change colour.

note: A rider on the bike is a trigger and is not judged.
